ValidationRule.description: to check if Status is Approved and 'Approved Credit' limit is provided
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $User.LastName <> 'Integration', OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Credit Card Cash Collateral Application'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cash Collateral Credit Limit Increase Application')), ISBLANK(cc_Approved_Credit_Limit__c), OR( AND( ISCHANGED(cc_HR_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_HR_Result__c,'Approved') ), AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Pre_Screening_Result__c,'Accept') )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the 'Approved Credit Limit' before 'Approving' the Case.
